product_scope: itpay is the single public Buyer CLI entry point, and $itpay is its user-facing Skill invocation. It covers services, railway planning and booking, orders, authorized purchased content and refunds.
title: Install And Identify The ItPay Agent Runtime
purpose: Install once in a permitted persistent location and enable the same-package Skill.
when_to_use: The CLI is being installed or upgraded.
The agent needs to confirm its stable runtime identity and default output Host.
current_flow: Use the authorized setup link’s channel/Backend and one host-permitted persistent npm tool location or global prefix. Retain that callable entry and actual Agent Type; no floating npx or project dependency edits.
Run itpay setup --agent-type <actual_type> --json once after installation/upgrade. setup_ready means device preparation; login_required can be a valid separate account status.
Read itpay skill show itpay --json and enable that exact package Skill via the host mechanism. Record the actual path and limitation if the host cannot enable it.
Do not repeat setup, installation or login for ordinary tasks. A nonzero install is not ready; keep the actual error and follow its current recovery.
